Subject: Delay on Private SDK + launch impact (requesting remediation)

Sofia —

We were planning our pilot launch for Sep 15 and the missing tenant-scoped routing in the Private SDK (and the instability on prefetch) has pushed our timeline out. Engineering has paused the rollout because the SDK exhibits higher tail latency under our workload and the current workarounds increase cost and complexity on our side.

This is putting pressure on our board timeline and procurement has asked for a commercial remediation (credit or extended trial) to cover the integration rework and delayed go-live. Can Redwood provide a short-term accommodation while you stabilize the VPC SDK? We'd like to understand what you can offer (credit, temporary rate) so procurement can decide.

Appreciate a prompt reply — we need a proposal by EOD Monday to keep this quarter's plan intact.

Thanks,

- ARR run rate for this opportunity: ~$450k first year (expansion upside)
- Customer pilot critical to close expansion in Q4
- Requested relief: unspecified credit/extended trial — they cited integration/ops cost plus board timing (see attached error logs they shared).

Suggested considerations: protect ARR and set precedent for other prelaunch customers. I think a milestone-based accommodation tied to launch milestones would align incentives (partial credit now, remainder on successful pilot go-live).

Can finance run an ROI on a one-time credit vs. risk of losing expansion? Aditya, can you propose a commercial figure we can offer quickly? Karthik, can product commit to prioritizing the SDK fixes and propose an ETA?

Sofia —

I ran quick math. Given the $450k first-year profile and strong expansion potential, I'd push for a targeted commercial that protects ACV but buys goodwill for a delayed pilot. Two quick options we could present to Olive:

Option A (simpler, faster to approve): $30,000 one-time credit applied in Q3 billing.
Option B (milestone-aligned, decreases payback risk): $15,000 credit now + $15,000 credit contingent on pilot go-live within 60 days (total $30,000).

I prefer Option B to keep us incentivized. Message for customer (short):

"We recognize the integration friction and want to support your pilot. We're prepared to offer a temporary accommodation of $30k split into an immediate credit plus a go-live contingent credit. We'll also prioritize the SDK issues with product to get you back on schedule — can we confirm an ETA for the fix by tomorrow?"

If finance wants to reduce exposure, we can make the second tranche contingent on usage thresholds or go-live confirmation from CS.

Let me know and I can surface to procurement.

— Aditya
